findings.finding: RiasecDeepCopySlotRegistry assets and locale metadata are fixed to zh-CN while RiasecPublicProjectionService can label the envelope en and still append those slots.
findings.boundary: English output must not contain Chinese reader copy; missing English must omit the module.

findings.finding: RiasecActivityExplorerService and RiasecExplorationFeedbackOverlayService use zh-CN-only asset paths; English assets are absent.
findings.boundary: Do not translate in fap-web and do not fall back to Chinese.

findings.finding: Seven English share/PDF/history rows exist, but asset_status and review_status remain draft_human_review_required while the loader treats file presence as available.
findings.boundary: Runtime safety is not content-complete or review-complete.

findings.finding: The assembler validates status, slot key, fields, and fallback flags but does not reject an en envelope containing zh-CN slots.
findings.boundary: Frontend must fail closed on envelope/slot/route locale mismatch without adding editorial copy.

findings.finding: The approved strategy is 20 unordered authored assets plus deterministic ordered emphasis. Runtime can derive 120 ordered codes, while current explicit audit matrix covers 20x3=60 representative codes.
findings.boundary: Do not author 120 new assets; extend deterministic QA to 120/120 before English runtime acceptance.

findings.finding: Current declared boundary treats RIASEC as career-interest direction and activity evidence only.
findings.boundary: No ability, personality identity, qualification, hiring, job-fit, income, success, or destiny claims.

findings.finding: Forms use different score spaces and current contracts block cross-form raw-score deltas.
findings.boundary: 140Q is contextual detail, not more accurate; it does not prove 60Q wrong.

findings.finding: Current contracts mark feedback and aspirations as overlays that do not mutate measured result or snapshot.
Private result route remains noindex and W4 introduces no public indexable surface.
